title: PHÁT TÀI PHÁT LỘC
description: A personal digital garden for books, games, notes, learning, training and small experiments.
why: I wanted one place on the internet that feels like my own room rather than a social profile.
learned: DNS, GitHub Pages, content structure and how to keep a personal website intentionally small.
next: Add richer book notes and a simple relationship graph.

title: Mendix experiments
description: Small low-code prototypes to understand what Mendix is good at in real work.
why: Learning by building is more memorable than reading feature lists.
learned: Microflows, data models and mobile-ready app structures.

title: PDF tools
description: Experiments around PDF processing, digital signatures and document workflows.
why: PDFs appear everywhere in office work and small automation gains are valuable.
learned: Document structure, signatures and practical automation constraints.

title: AI experiments
description: Tiny experiments that use AI only where it adds real utility.
why: To learn what becomes easier with AI and what should stay simple.
learned: Good prompts matter, but product structure matters more.
next: Try note classification and naming suggestions.
